input.brief: Finestkraft: a Cairo brand and web studio for founder-led tech and AI companies, projects from $1999

direction.name: Colour chapters
direction.idea: Every section is a chapter with its own flat colour, floor to ceiling. The page reads like a set of posters hung in a row, held together by one typeface and one grid. The colours are not decoration: they come from the subject (the brand's packaging, the artist's record sleeves, the product's own colour ways, the categories of the content) and each chapter's colour means that chapter. Decide the sequence like a designer orders a book: a strong opener, a quiet second, a surprise in the middle, a dark or very light closer.
direction.composition: Sections are full-bleed fields, each at least 90svh tall, butted directly against each other with no gap and no divider. Inside every field the same 12-column grid and the same margins apply, and each field holds one thing: a huge heading (8–12vw) with a small paragraph, or one photograph with a caption, or one list. Text colour is chosen per field for strong contrast (ink or paper, never grey). Headings start on the same left edge in every chapter, so the eye feels the system as colours change. The navigation and the footer take the colours of the first and last chapter.
direction.typography: One typeface in two weights. Headings very large and tight; body 18–20px. Because colour is loud, the type stays plain: no italics, no second face.
direction.colour: Four to six flat fields used at full strength, one per section, each with its assigned text colour. No tints, no gradients between them: the hard edge where two fields meet is the look.
direction.imagery: Sparing. One photograph or object per chapter at most, either cut out and sitting directly on the colour, or a plain rectangle with generous colour around it. Photographs should be simple enough not to fight the field.
direction.richness: Colour at scale. A whole screen of one saturated colour is rich on its own, so a chapter needs few elements; it still needs its content at full size, because a coloured screen with one small line on it reads as empty.
direction.pitfalls: Check contrast on every field with the palette's assigned ink. Do not put cards on the fields. Do not use more than six colours. Two neighbouring fields should differ clearly in lightness as well as hue.

hero.name: Giant cropped shape
hero.blueprint: A plain ground with one flat shape at enormous scale. The shape is the simplest geometry found in the subject (a circle, a ring segment, a chamfered block, an arch), drawn in CSS or as a single inline SVG path and filled with the accent colour. It is about 120vh across and enters from the right, centred near 78% of the width and 55% of the height, so the top, right and bottom edges of the viewport crop it and its left boundary reaches column 7. If the subject has a true pair (two accounts, two modes), a second shape in a second flat colour overlaps the first by a quarter with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. The headline sits on the bare ground on columns 1–6, vertically centred, flush left at 8% from the left edge: two lines at clamp(64px, 6.4vw, 100px), heavy weight, tracking -0.03em. Beneath it comes one supporting sentence at 19px, then the single action as a solid button cut to the same shape. A bold wordmark sits top-left at 32px; up to three text links sit top-right in the ground colour.
hero.mobile: The shape moves to the bottom: 130vw across, centred horizontally, its top at 56svh, cropped by the left, right and bottom edges. The headline sits above it at 11.5vw on two lines at a 16px margin, starting 15% down, with the sentence at 16px and the motif-shaped button beneath. Wordmark top-left; the links collapse to one word top-right.
hero.headline: Two lines of two or three words each, up to about 12 characters per line at 6.4vw.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Specimens on colour tiles
sections.blueprint: Each capability is represented by one object photographed alone and shown on a flat colour tile. Columns 1–3 hold the heading (two to four words at 40–52px), top-aligned, with a 30ch sentence beneath and nothing else down the rest of that column. Columns 4–12 hold a grid of five or six tiles in two rows with 10px gaps: tiles are 4:5 except one, which is double width at 8:5 and placed second in the first row. Tile colours rotate through three palette fields. Each photograph is centred at about 70% of its tile's height; on light tiles use mix-blend-mode: multiply so a white studio background disappears. Under each tile, outside it and aligned to its left edge: the capability name at 20px medium and one fact at 16px in the soft ink. No text on the tiles and no hover lift.
sections.mobile: The heading and its sentence sit on top at full width. Tiles become a two-column grid with 8px gaps; the double tile spans both columns at 8:5 and comes first. Names shrink to 17px and facts to 15px, still under each tile.

sections.name: Stacked folders with tabs
sections.blueprint: Projects are filed as folders: four to six full-width flat colour bands stacked so that each shows a 64px strip above the next, built with `position: sticky` and increasing `top` offsets (0, 64, 128px) so the bands pile up as the page scrolls. From the top-left edge of each band one or two tabs rise: filled shapes 44px tall and 200–320px wide with shouldered corners cut by `clip-path: polygon()` or an inline SVG path, side by side with 6px gaps, each in a flat colour that contrasts with its band. The project name sits inside the tab at 26–28px; the category sits right-aligned in the band's visible strip at 15px. An open band is 80svh: a 16:10 photograph in columns 1–7 and, top-aligned in columns 9–12, a 60-word description with a link. A two-word heading at 32px precedes the stack.
sections.mobile: Bands do not stick; they stack in normal flow, each led by one tab 40px tall with the name at 20px and the category beside it. Inside a band the photograph is full width at 4:3 with the description beneath at 16px and 20px padding.

sections.name: Accordion of tinted panels
sections.blueprint: A two-column introduction, then one horizontal accordion. Introduction: the heading, two to four words at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px), in columns 1–5; one paragraph at 18px in columns 7–11. 64px below, a flex row across columns 1–12, 520px tall, of four to six panels with no gaps. The open stage is a panel taking about 58% of the width; the rest are vertical slivers sharing what remains. Order is carried by colour: the first stage is the darkest tone of one hue and each later stage is a lighter flat tint of it, so the row reads dark to light from left to right. A sliver shows only its stage name, rotated 90 degrees and reading upward, at 20px bold, anchored to its bottom-left. The open panel shows the name at 40px top-left, a 36ch paragraph at 18px bottom-left and, optionally, one photograph in its right half. Clicking a sliver opens it (flex-basis transition, 450ms).
sections.mobile: The accordion turns vertical: stages stack at full width as bars 64px tall in the same dark-to-light order, names set horizontally at 18px. The open stage expands to its content height with the paragraph at 17px. The first stage is open by default.

sections.name: One plan as a sentence
sections.blueprint: The whole offer is one sentence of five to seven short words that contains the price, set at 8–9vw across the full width on two lines, leading 0.95, flush left; it replaces any heading. The price is not styled as a different word. Instead it sits on a filled block of the accent colour exactly one line-height tall with 0.15em of padding at each side, so the figure reads as an object in the line. Below, on one shared baseline 64px under the sentence: a supporting sentence at 20px in columns 1–6 saying what the price includes, and one rectangular button right-aligned in columns 10–12. If a second option exists (annual, team), it is a plain text link under the button, not a second panel. The section is one flat colour field at least 80svh tall.
sections.mobile: The sentence is set at 11vw on two lines, with the price block on a line of its own between them, as wide as its figure. The supporting sentence follows at 17px, then a full-width button, then the text link for the second option.

sections.name: Inset panel, shaped portrait
sections.blueprint: A deep-toned panel inset 20px from the page edges with a 12px radius, about 110svh tall, `overflow: hidden`. Left half: a two-line statement of four to seven words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 64px) in a pale ink, top-left with 56px padding; it is the heading and has nothing above it. Below it a photograph of the person or the workshop, masked with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask` to one bold shape taken from the subject (a four-lobed flower, a circle, an arch, a chamfered block), 38vw across, positioned so the panel's bottom edge crops its lowest fifth. Right side, starting at 63% of the width and 56px from the top: two text blocks 300px wide and 64px apart, each a subhead at 22px over a four-line paragraph at 15px; then one solid button in the accent colour. Between the statement and the text blocks the panel is empty. One photograph only.
sections.mobile: The panel is inset 10px and stacks: the statement at 8.5vw, then the two text blocks at full width, the button, and last the shaped photograph at 86vw across, centred and cropped by the panel's bottom edge by a quarter of its height.

sections.name: A band per question
sections.blueprint: Each question owns a full-bleed band, and the bands alternate between two flat tones (ground and one step away, or two palette colours with their assigned inks) and butt together with no gap. Inside every band the same grid applies: the question in columns 1–5 at 28–32px bold, top-aligned with 56px of padding above; the answer in columns 7–12 at 18px with leading 1.5, the same padding, and 56px below. Bands are as tall as their content, so their heights differ, which gives the stack its rhythm. Four to seven bands. The heading is the first band: two to four words at about 7vw on the accent colour, flush left, taller than the rest at about 40svh with the words anchored to its bottom-left. All answers are visible; there are no toggles.
sections.mobile: Bands stay full-bleed and alternate. Inside each, the question at 22px then the answer at 17px, with 32px padding top and bottom and 20px at the sides. The heading band is 30svh tall with its words at 13vw at the bottom-left.

sections.name: Statement, table pushed right
sections.blueprint: A heading of four to six words spans the full width on two lines at clamp(40px, 4.5vw, 68px), left-aligned with its first line indented 3vw and leading 0.98. 96px below, the table is pushed into the right-hand five columns (8–12) and the left stays open. One plain word naming the table (offices, hours, rates) hangs at 14px in column 7, top-aligned with the first row. Each row is a three-part line at 15–16px with 26px between rows: the kind or day in the soft ink at the left of the measure, the place or service at 30%, and the address, time or price right-aligned, with a small arrow where the row links. Rows are separated by space only; every fourth row has 44px above it to form groups. In columns 1–4, bottom-aligned with the last row, one 4:5 photograph 22vw wide may sit alone. Holds 5–14 rows.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9.5vw without the indent. The table takes the full width at 16px; each row stacks the kind above the place, with the value right-aligned on the first line. The naming word is dropped because the heading already says it. The photograph follows at 60% width on the right margin.

sections.name: The idea again, inverted
sections.blueprint: The close flips the page's colours: ink becomes the ground and the ground becomes the ink, across a full-bleed field at least 90svh tall. The page's opening idea returns as a headline of three to five words at 9–11vw on two lines, leading 0.9, flush left, positioned in the upper two-thirds; it should echo the hero's wording, not repeat it. Along the bottom, on one shared baseline 40px above the edge: one supporting sentence at 20px in columns 1–5 and one rectangular button in the accent colour, right-aligned in columns 10–12, about 56px tall. Nothing else: no image, no second button, no logo. The field's top edge is a hard horizontal line where it meets the section above. If the footer follows on the same inverted field, leave 160px before it so the close still reads as its own screen.
sections.mobile: The same inverted field at 80svh. Headline at 15vw on two lines at the top. The sentence sits lower at 17px, and the button spans the full width at the bottom, 56px tall, with 20px margins. Nothing else is added.

sections.name: Name first, places under it
sections.blueprint: The wordmark opens the footer instead of closing it. On a full-bleed field in the page's inverse or final chapter colour, the name spans the full content width as the first thing, its cap line pushed 8% above the footer's top edge so the tops of the letters are sliced off by the section (`overflow: hidden` and a negative top margin in `em`). 72px beneath, a two-part row: columns 1–5 list the places or ways to reach the studio (cities, or email and telephone), one per line at 32–36px in the accent ink, each a link; columns 7–12 hold three columns of small links at 15px, top-aligned with the first place. A final row 96px lower carries the legal line at the left and a back-to-top text link at the right, both 13px. The field is about 90svh tall, and nothing sits between the wordmark and the row but space.
sections.mobile: The sliced wordmark stays at the top, fitted to the width. Places follow as a list at 26px, then the link columns two across at 15px. Legal line and back-to-top link share the last row at 12px, at opposite margins.

references.name: Anidachi
references.idea: A toy brand built from one custom modular wordmark and one 3D device, both of which change colour with each full-bleed candy-coloured section.
references.hero: A saturated sky-blue field covering the top 92% of the viewport. The custom modular wordmark is repeated in four stacked rows, each spanning the full width inside 30px margins, drawn tone-on-tone in a slightly lighter blue that brightens row by row toward the bottom, so the name works as wallpaper. A tiny white pixel-cat mark sits top-left; a white rounded button with blue text top-right. A 3D flower-shaped toy device hangs on a carabiner from the top edge at centre, barely entered on desktop and fully visible on mobile, where it covers the pattern. A pale ice section starts at the bottom edge.
references.type: AnidachiDisplay is custom modular lettering: monoline rounded strokes on a square grid, unicase forms, used at 7-10vw. Body and UI in Ease, a soft rounded geometric sans, at 20px. Text is always coloured to its section, never black.
references.colour: #24c0fe #eff9fb #b6c814 #ff6b2b #ffffff #000000 — Each section is one flat saturated field (sky blue, ice, chartreuse, orange) with type in a single contrasting tint of the same family or white. The 3D device is recoloured to match its section.
references.imagery: A glossy flower-shaped handheld with cream buttons and a small black screen showing pixel-art animal characters, hung from a metal clasp. Pixel sprites also appear loose on the page and as a giant low-contrast watermark.
references.layout: Full-bleed colour sections of one to two screens with 30px margins. Each holds one giant display phrase at an edge, one small text block, and the 3D device crossing section boundaries. Alignment shifts section to section: centred, left column, bottom-left.

sections.description: Pale ice section. Centred: the small mascot mark and wordmark in sky blue at about 9vw, followed by a two-line statement in the rounded sans at 7vw in the same blue. Below, a left column 370px wide holds a three-line 24px lead and small paragraphs, all blue on ice; a pixel-art cat sprite stands in the right half, and a pill-outlined email field with a round arrow button ends the block.

Chartreuse full-bleed section. A title in the modular display face runs edge to edge in white at about 10vw across the top. The 3D device, recoloured olive to match, hangs from its clasp at left-centre and overlaps a diagonal ribbon of translucent rounded-square tiles, each holding a tinted character, running from lower-left to upper-right and off the edge.

Solid orange section, almost empty. A three-line 14px white paragraph sits near the top, right of centre; the bottom-left holds a two-line hyphenated phrase in the display face at roughly 9vw, white, hugging the left margin and the bottom edge. The lower edge of the device intrudes from the section above.

Ice ground with an enormous pixel-art face in a barely darker green tint as a watermark filling the frame. Lime wordmark lower-left at about 300px wide, three stacked lime links at centre, one link at right, tiny copyright beneath the logo.

steal: Repeat the wordmark as tone-on-tone rows filling the hero, stepping the tint row by row, so the brand name is the background pattern.
Give every section one saturated colour, set all its text in a single contrasting tint, and recolour the 3D product to match.
Anchor a giant two-line display phrase to the bottom-left corner of an otherwise empty colour field, with one small paragraph far away at the top.

references.name: Ai in Design Report 2026
references.idea: A research report laid out like a colour-blocked print annual: a thermal-blurred video collage on top, an oversized tight grotesk title, and flat orange, lilac, sage and black blocks carrying stats, quotes and chapters.
references.hero: The top 53% is a full-width video band: blurred, heat-map-like abstract footage in orange, lilac and sage, overlaid with four or five hard-edged rectangles of the same footage in grey or green, two tagged with tiny mono labels in white boxes. The header sits flush on top: a black logo block at far left, an orange link tab running to 40% of the width, two plain links at right. Below the band, on white: a two-line deck at about 1.4vw on a 1% left margin, and from 42% across a two-line title at 8.3vw, medium weight, tracking -0.06em. Bottom row: mono credit left, scroll cue and arrow aligned to the title column.
references.type: Beausite Classic, a grotesk with some stroke contrast, in Medium for titles and Regular for text; sentence case, tracking -0.06em at display size. Geist Mono for small uppercase labels. Steps: 8.3vw title, about 5.5vw numerals, about 3vw statements, 16px body, 10px mono. Footer wordmark near 96vw.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #fe7141 #cdabfe #d1ddd3 #f0ff1c — White base with flat blocks of orange, lilac, sage and black assigned to whole modules (stat tiles, quote panels, chapter bands), all drawn from the hero footage. Text is black, or off-white on black.
references.imagery: Hero: abstract blurred video with a heat-map grade, cut into overlapping rectangles. Body: warm documentary photos and clips of people at desks in wood-lined rooms, square-cornered, butted directly against flat colour blocks with no gap.
references.layout: 1% margins and a recurring column line at about 42% where most headings and text begin. Open white text passages ruled by hairlines alternate with tight mosaics in which photos and colour blocks share edges. Each chapter opens with a full-width colour band.

sections.description: A full-width hairline, a tiny mono label at the left, then seven black partner logos evenly spaced across the full width in one row with generous padding above and below, closed by a second hairline. Immediately beneath, another mono label and a three-line statement at about 3vw, flush left and occupying only the left half, followed by a full-width photo strip.

A mosaic with no gutters. A photo of two people at a laptop fills the left two-thirds at roughly 1:1; the right third is split into two stacked flat tiles, lilac above and sage below. Each tile carries a large numeral with a plus sign at about 5.5vw in its top-left corner and a two-line caption directly beneath; the rest of the tile is empty colour.

Quote module as two abutting blocks: a black block on the left 40% holding only a small name and a mono role caption, and a sage block on the right 60% with the quotation at about 3vw, top-left aligned with empty sage beneath. Directly below, a full-width orange band opens a chapter: hairline at top, a large two-digit number with the chapter word under it at left, a two-line title and small paragraph starting at the 42% column.

Black footer. A row of three small source counts along the top, separated by vertical hairlines, then the report name in off-white heavy type at nearly full viewport width with a trademark sign at its top-right, then the year at the same size right-aligned on a second line. Two small link columns with mono headings sit lower left beside the year; a hairline and one row of credits and partner logos close it.

steal: Start most headings and text at a fixed column line about 42% across, leaving the left for small decks, credits and chapter numbers.
Butt flat colour tiles directly against a photograph with no gutter and put one large numeral plus two caption lines in each tile's top-left corner.
Take the page's flat block colours from the hero footage so the abstract video and the layout read as one palette.
references.media: A video collage covers 100% of the screen at load and lifts to the top ~53% to uncover the title on white. Below, a documentary photograph two thirds wide in a sticky frame beside stacked colour stat blocks, a pinned deck of colour cards each with a 10s clip docked bottom-left, and a carousel of equal stills running off the right edge: 12 images and 6 muted videos, all square-cornered.
references.motion: No preloader, but the collage re-cuts itself for about 4s before the title lands. Framer drives the sticky stacking (a 1350px photo frame and three 900px chapter cards that peel away to uncover the next); there is no split text, links change colour over .2s cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1), and one panel slides 610px in over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.37,1).

references.name: Pensatori Irrazionali
references.idea: The client roster becomes the hero object, a 3D sheaf of logo-printed fabric ribbons, and classical Italian ornament (copperplate script, engravings, tricolour) is collided with plain Helvetica.
references.archetype: other: offset 3d object with bottom-left statement
references.hero: Flat pale-grey field (#f5f5f5). A 3D-rendered bundle of woven fabric ribbons, each a different saturated colour and printed with a client logo, streams diagonally from beyond the top-right corner down to about centre-left, covering roughly the right two-thirds and bleeding off the top and right edges. Top-left: a small engraved lion crest with serif wordmark and a green-white-red bar. Top-right: two dark square icon buttons with chamfered corners. Bottom-left, in the lowest fifth: a tiny '+ (Atelier)' label above a three-line grey intro paragraph at about 36px, half the viewport wide. No headline and no call to action; the left third is empty.
references.type: Helvetica Now at regular weight does nearly everything, tracking -0.025em, sentence case, from 14px body to 60px menu links. Section titles pair it with huge hairline copperplate script words, and the footer wordmark is a heavy high-contrast serif at about 18vw.
references.colour: #f5f5f5 #434343 #292828 #e9e9e9 #e3342a #2bd92b — One pale grey ground throughout with charcoal rather than black text. Saturated colour is confined to the ribbon render and project images, plus a green and red flag underline and one neon-green dot.
references.imagery: Hero 3D render of logo-printed textile ribbons; black engraved illustrations (angel, Pegasus, lion) cut out and placed inside headings; dark-grey map silhouettes; square-cornered project stills in a horizontal row.
references.layout: Narrow 48px side margins with content hung on a loose two-column split at 50%. Sections alternate between oversized title bands that bleed off both edges and small hairline-ruled tabular lists, with generous blank grey between blocks.

sections.description: A title band runs edge to edge as one line: a hairline copperplate script word about 250px tall cropped by the left edge, a tiny superscript '(01)', a black engraving of an angel dropped in like an inline glyph, then a grotesk phrase at 90px running off the right edge. Beneath, two columns of client rows: name at about 40px, a tiny grey category label, the client's logo mark, a small arrow, each row closed by a hairline.

A grid of five columns by two rows of equal cells with faint 1px borders, each holding one small monochrome client logo, centred. Directly below, a wide empty band works as a map: a dark-grey country silhouette crops in at each side edge, with a two-line place name at 32px bottom-left and another bottom-right, each with tiny coordinates in parentheses underneath.

The same script-plus-engraving title band, now with a Pegasus and '(02)'. Below, a two-column table headed by tiny 'Number' and 'Service' labels over a hairline: the left column shows a giant hairline script numeral about 200px tall; the right holds a small '+ (Branding)' label, a service name with a neon-green dot, and ruled rows pairing a term at left with a grey descriptor right-aligned.

The first word of the name in a heavy high-contrast serif spans the full width and crops at the right edge (about 18vw), with a green underline under its left half and red under its right. Behind and below, the second word in giant pale-grey gradient script overlaps the serif letters. Under that, small columns: menu links at 18px, contact details at 11px, legal links at right.

steal: Turn the client-logo list into one physical object (logos printed on a rendered bundle of ribbons) so proof becomes the hero image instead of a logo strip.
Build section titles as one edge-to-edge line mixing a hairline script word, an inline engraved illustration and a plain grotesk phrase at similar height.
Keep the page on one pale grey with charcoal text and let colour enter only through imagery and a single flag-coloured underline on the footer wordmark.
references.media: A 3D cluster of logo-printed fabric ribbons covers about 60% of the first screen, bleeding off the top and right with the statement docked bottom-left. Below: engravings inserted between the words of a title marquee, hidden 16:9 previews behind a client index, three-up 16:9 tile rows overflowing the right edge as carousels, a single centred 16:9 video with wide ground either side, a staggered two-row collage bleeding off both edges, and map silhouettes cropped at the page edges; 39 images and 9 muted 16:9 videos, never under text.
references.motion: About 3-4s of intro after a 13.3s load: an inset crest card where a 2.25s fill keyframe runs, a white flash, the ribbons, then the copy de-blurring. Lenis with no pins: titles run as endless marquees, media rows are carousels, and content fades back in over 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) after each scroll step; coordinates roll digit by digit over 900ms on a spring-shaped linear() curve (157 WAAPI calls), and the manifesto letters roll up from doubled glyphs.
